preconditions.description: The length of the array arr is between 1 and 1000.
Each string in the array arr has a length between 1 and 30.

postconditions.expression: output == '' or (output in arr and all(output.startswith(s) for s in arr if s != output))
postconditions.description: The output is either an empty string or a string that is in the input array and is the lexicographically smallest string that has all its prefixes present in the input array.

postconditions.expression: output == '' or max(len(s) for s in arr if s.startswith(output[0]) and all(s.startswith(p) for p in arr if p != s)) == len(output)
postconditions.description: The output is either an empty string or the longest string that has all its prefixes present in the input array.
